mentions.name: WithAudio
mentions.description: A text-to-speech reader that converts text into audio. It originally generated speech paragraph by paragraph and is being reworked to generate sentence by sentence so users can start listening sooner, with two additional languages planned.
mentions.problem: Generating speech paragraph by paragraph meant users sometimes had to wait for the whole paragraph to be ready before they could listen.

mentions.name: WithAudio
mentions.description: WithAudio is a one-time payment desktop text-to-speech reader app. It runs entirely without a server, which eliminates recurring costs and keeps usage 100% private. It has sold licenses and is being refined using bug reports from a reviewer who received a free license in exchange for detailed private feedback.

mentions.name: WithAudio
mentions.description: A one-time payment text-to-speech desktop app that runs entirely locally for privacy. It includes a PDF parser that extracts PDF content with correct paragraph breaks on the user's computer, and a browser extension is in development that talks to the locally running app so WithAudio can be used in the browser with good performance and 100% local processing.
mentions.problem: The author believes tools like text-to-speech don't have to be subscription-based, so WithAudio uses a one-time payment instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm still working on WithAudio (https://desktop.with.audio). A one time payment Text To Speech Desktop App. Because I think everything doesn't have to be a subscription.

mentions.name: WithAudio
mentions.description: WithAudio is a desktop text-to-speech application for macOS (Apple Silicon) that runs 100% locally and privately with no data sent to servers, sold as a one-time payment. Users can import any text, URL, or ebooks and use a reader with read-along text highlighting, export the audio as mp3 or m4a audiobook files, and use Global Capture hotkeys to import text and URLs from anywhere. It currently supports only English, and a website Reader view mimics the app's features within browser limitations.
